usedFor: Plunk holds your contacts, and HubSpot receives each new one through “Create Contact” for sales follow-up.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact Is Added” in Plunk, then “Create Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: The action requires an email, so the Plunk contact's address carries over to the new HubSpot record.

watchOut: “Update Company” in HubSpot needs a company ID, so supply one when mapping from Plunk.
